## 1 · Status
🟡 The last task (meta tags for the construction-lawyer page) was delivered **broken**: all four outputs exceed the character limits the user set, and they mix NSW with Adelaide. The user has not noticed or complained yet. Everything else is finished Q&A. One question from the user (file organisation, 05-27) was never answered.

## 2 · Picture
Latest work (05-28 18:16 onward): the user is rewriting a service article, "Types of Construction Contracts SA", for **homeowners in Adelaide / South Australia**. The agent plays a construction lawyer with 10+ years' experience and writes in AU English. Keywords to weave in naturally: "types of construction contracts", "construction contracts". The user sends the reference article one part at a time and wants each part rewritten as it arrives. Part 8 ("Why should you trust…") was rewritten: rename "Contracts Specialist" to **"Construction Lawyer Adelaide"**, keep the POV, add a CTA, use SA law. Earlier parts are not in this context.
- SEO title the agent suggested: "Construction Contracts in South Australia: How a Construction Lawyer Adelaide Can Help Homeowners".
- The user then asked for a Meta Title "for the NSW homeowner" (≤70 chars), a Meta Description (≤155), an OG Title "as close as possible to the Meta Title" (≤60), and an OG Description (≤110).

**Open question (not settled):** the user wrote "NSW" although the whole article is about Adelaide/SA. This is probably a template slip, but the user said NSW `[user said]`. Ask, or offer both versions. Don't silently pick one.

## 3 · Next actions
1. Fix the meta set. Measured lengths of what the agent delivered `[verified: python len()]`:
   - Meta Title "Expert Construction Contract Review | NSW Homeowners | Construction Lawyer Adelaide" = **83** (limit 70)
   - Meta Description "Looking for a reliable construction contract lawyer in NSW? …Book your free consultation today." = **200** (limit 155). It also mentions "debt recovery", which the article never covers.
   - OG Title "Building Contracts NSW: Construction Lawyer Review | Small Builders" = **67** (limit 60). It isn't close to the Meta Title, and "Small Builders" is the wrong persona (the audience is homeowners).
   - OG Description "Get expert help from Construction Lawyer Adelaide. …Book now!" = **149** (limit 110)
   Done when every string is verified with a character count, aimed at homeowners, includes a keyword, and the NSW/SA question has been raised.
2. If the user sends more article parts, apply the same rules as Part 8 (see §2).
3. The 05-27 file-organisation thread ended with the user's open questions (§6b). If the user returns to it, answer them.
